title: Preschool Teacher’s Behavior Toward Toddler Goes Too Far
description:
On January 9th, 2024. A preschool director called 911 regarding disturbing footage she saw of a teacher grabbing and slamming a toddler onto his seat.  When police were conducting an interview with her, she kept trying to justify her actions.
